about_the_game:
About This Demo

Experience the opening chapter of Pompeii: The Legacy, a story-driven Roman city-building strategy game with rich RPG elements.

In this demo, you will lay the foundations of a new Pompeii, manage vital resources, and make crucial decisions for your chosen noble family, all while preparing for the challenges that lie ahead. The demo introduces key gameplay systems including construction, trade, political influence, and family-based development, giving you a strong taste of what’s to come in the full game.

This version includes a guided tutorial woven into the campaign, making it ideal for new players while still offering enough freedom for veterans of the genre to explore mechanics at their own pace.

Key Features in the Demo:

  • Founding Your City – Begin your journey with a family of your choice, each offering unique bonuses and playstyles.

  • Economy & Trade – Set up production chains and trade routes, manage goods and grow your city's influence.

  • Narrative Choices – Make story-driven decisions that impact your family’s legacy.

  • City Building – Construct homes, civic buildings, shrines, and infrastructure to expand your settlement.

  • Tactical Pause – Manage your city and prepare for future RTS-style challenges with the help of tactical pausing.

  • Integrated Tutorial – Learn the basics while playing through the early campaign.

This demo covers the early stages of the full campaign, offering 1–2 hours of structured gameplay, depending on your pace and playstyle. It serves as an introduction to Pompeii’s systems, world, and atmosphere, and lays the groundwork for deeper political, military, and narrative systems coming in the full version.
